<!-- Offer readiness check (quote to cash) · from Chapter 24 of The Product 360 Handbook -->

# Offer readiness check · [Offer name] · [Date]

**Launch date:** [ ]   **Owner:** [PM]   **Go / no-go decision maker:** [Name]

| Stage | Question | Owner | Status (Ready / Gap / N/A) | Gap and fix date |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Offer configuration | Is every SKU, edition and add-on configured, with rules for valid combinations? | Sales operations | | |
| Pricing | Are list prices, discount guardrails and approval levels set? | Pricing or finance | | |
| Quoting | Can a rep produce a correct quote for each edition, region and channel without help? | Sales operations | | |
| Contract management | Are the terms, unit definitions, AI terms and data processing terms approved? | Legal | | |
| Orders | Can orders be booked and provisioned, including entitlements and limits? | Operations | | |
| Billing | Can billing measure and charge every unit of charge, with the data needed for disputes? | Billing and engineering | | |
| Payment and collections | Are payment terms and collections processes ready, including for partners? | Finance | | |
| Revenue recognition | Has revenue accounting identified the separate promises and any variable consideration? | Revenue accounting | | |
| Renewal | Is the renewal, upgrade and migration path defined? | Customer success | | |
| Partners | Can partners quote, order and bill this offer, or is it labeled direct-only for now? | Partner team | | |
| Claims | Is every external claim in the claims log and approved? | PMM and legal | | |

**Decision:** Go / Go with scope reduced (what is labeled "coming" and when) / No-go
